sections.name: Your House 1F

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14
a 2-tile-wide staircase UP against the back wall in the top-right corner (columns 12–13, rows 3–4)

sections.look: the hero's home, ground floor, inside a small round honey-sandstone dome: curved sandstone walls with round windows, a kitchen counter and stove along the back wall, one wooden kitchen table, a dish towel by the door, a warm cinnamon-and-pancakes feel
sections.story_note: Hero's home ground floor: Mom's kitchen table, stove, TV, stairs up, door at bottom

sections.name: Your House 2F

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide staircase DOWN against the back wall in the top-right corner (columns 12–13, rows 3–4)

sections.look: the hero's small upstairs bedroom inside the sandstone dome: curved walls, a bunk bed with an old quilt against one wall, a round window with a brass telescope standing beside it, a wall calendar crossed off in red, a jacket hook
sections.story_note: Hero's bedroom: bed, desk with game console, telescope at the window, poster of the Starfall, stairs down

sections.name: Vashti's Observatory Lab

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Dr. Vashti's round domed Observatory lab at the top of the 112 steps: tall bookshelves of books, scrolls and glowing jars around the curved walls, star charts pinned up, a giant brass telescope under the dome against the back wall, a big brass table by the window with three brass-rimmed glass capsules on velvet cushions, one computer with a round green screen
sections.story_note: Domed lab with a big brass telescope, three capsule pedestals for the starters on a table, computers, bookshelves

sections.name: Dustmere Plaza

exits.where: a round landing pad (6×6 tiles, flat, walkable, no ship drawn) at the left end of the main road where your starship sets down
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

sections.look: Dustmere, the canyon town where three red canyons meet: a wide sandstone-paved main street, the Recovery Bay dome, a small shop dome, the hero's dome house and the empty dome house next door, and the white Observatory dome at the top of a short wide flight of stone steps; the Bonfire Ring (a flat circle of stones, walkable) in the open plaza below the street
sections.story_note: Home town: hero's house, Vashti's observatory dome, Recovery Bay, shop, the bridge exit east, trading post south

sections.name: Dustmere Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14
a 2-tile-wide wooden ladder UP to the attic against the back wall in the top-right corner (columns 12–13, rows 3–4)

sections.look: Dustmere Recovery Bay inside the round white dome: clean white curved walls, a curved nurse's counter against the back wall, healing machines like giant glass seashells glowing soft gold behind the counter, a PC terminal against a side wall

sections.name: Dustmere Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Dustmere shop inside a small honey-sandstone dome: shelves along the walls with cactus fruit, strings of dried peppers, glittering canyon crystals, jars of honey and spare robot parts; one shop counter against the back wall; warm sandstone floor, brass pipes on the walls

sections.name: Dustmere Bridge
sections.look: the ancient bridge at the bottom of Dustmere's deepest canyon: a long, wide arch of huge pale stone blocks with NO railings, every block carved with swirling marks that glow bright electric blue, spanning a deep dark chasm between two red canyon walls; night-time light, the blue glow lighting the red rock
sections.story_note: The humming canyon bridge (story: Zib's signal, M02). Long wooden-and-brass bridge over a deep canyon, glowing rune lamps

sections.name: Trading Post
sections.look: the Trading Post where the desert road comes into town: a tidy row of wooden market stalls with red-and-yellow striped awnings and patched canvas tents along the top of the map, a big corral of split-rail fence (open, walkable inside) beside the road, a water tower on stilts with a creaky windmill in a corner, red dirt underfoot
sections.story_note: Small outpost of stalls and a corral where Sola waits (M03 first rival battle)

sections.name: Rimwalk Trail Part A
sections.look: the Rimwalk Trail along the canyon rim: a wide red-dirt trail, patches of drift grass, a few low one-way rock ledges, red boulders and sage scrub along the edges, the canyon drop as the bottom border
sections.story_note: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

sections.name: Rimwalk Trail Part B
sections.look: the Rimwalk Trail continued: wide red sandstone trail, drift-grass patches, barrel cacti and sun-baked boulders along the edges, deep red canyon drop along one side
sections.story_note: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

sections.name: Cactus Gardens
sections.look: the Cactus Gardens, a wide sunny bowl entered between two big red boulders (the Gateposts): giant armed cacti taller than houses, barrel and paddle cacti topped with hot-pink, yellow, purple and cherry-red flowers, all standing in solid blocks along the edges; wide sandy lanes between them; patches of drift grass; one big flat sitting rock
sections.story_note: Maze of tall cacti and flowering succulents, drift grass, hidden items

sections.name: Sunset Tunnel B1
sections.look: the Sunset Tunnel through the purple Sunset Range: a wide tunnel of cool, damp old purple-gray stone, lanterns on iron hooks along the walls each burning a small BLUE flame, pools of light on the floor; the entrance is a huge round arch carved with the same swirling marks as the Dustmere bridge
sections.story_note: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

sections.name: Sunset Tunnel B2
sections.look: the deeper Sunset Tunnel: wide old-stone passage, blue-flame lanterns on iron hooks along the walls, and near the top exit the stone warms to a deep furnace-orange glow
sections.story_note: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Tunnel Mouth
sections.look: the Sunset Tunnel's exit onto a high black cliff above the Molten Frontier: a wide, straight path of flat black stone leading away from the tunnel, lava rivers running down the black rock on either side, steam drifting
sections.story_note: Exit of Sunset Tunnel onto volcanic far side

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part A
sections.look: the Ash Trail: flat black volcanic ash ground crossed by cooling lava channels (bridged where the trail crosses them), black rock outcrops, white steam

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B
sections.look: the Ash Trail continued: black ash flats and cooling lava channels, steam vents, rough basalt boulders, and along one edge black rock meeting the glowing turquoise sea in clouds of steam

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Palm Isle
sections.look: Palm Isle, a round green island in steamy turquoise sea: leaning palms and big red flowers along the edges, a wide causeway of flat stepping stones joined into a solid path, and Nurse Coral's small round white Recovery Hut with a glowing blue cross and a porch of palm-frond hammocks
sections.story_note: Tropical island with Recovery Hut, palm trees, turquoise water

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Port Ember

exits.where: the Relay Gate at the harbor end: two barnacled pale-stone pillars and an arch carved with the Lady of the Gate's face, standing in the upper band with a 6-tile-wide plank landing in front of it (warp to Thalassa, 052)

sections.look: Port Ember, a fishing village on wooden stilts over turquoise water: houses painted yellow, cherry red, sky blue and mint with peeling paint, a wide plank boardwalk street, nets drying on rails, colored-glass lanterns on the roofs, and at the harbor end the Relay Gate: two barnacled pale-stone pillars and an arch rising from the sea, carved with a woman's serene face (the Lady of the Gate)
sections.story_note: Harbor village with the harbor Relay Gate (needs 2 Shards)

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Long Dock

exits.where: the Deep Sea Ferry moored at the end of the pier with a 4-tile-wide boarding plank (warp to Glyphos, 072)

sections.look: the Long Dock past Port Ember's stilt houses: a long, wide plank pier on seaweed-hung posts over dark glassy water, dock lanterns glowing gold in a purple-orange-pink sunset; moored at the pier's end, the Deep Sea Ferry, a round glass bubble boat with brass ribs and a propeller; an upturned barrel on the pier
sections.story_note: Long wooden dock where the Deep Sea Ferry berths (M08 Sola's Choice scene)

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part A
sections.look: Ridge Path climbing the volcanic ridge: a wide black-rock path, thin lava trickles in channels on both sides, old wooden warning boards (blank) on iron spikes, low one-way rock ledges

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B
sections.look: Ridge Path upper stretch: black rock and lava trickles, blank wooden warning boards on iron spikes, mine-cart rails and ore carts appearing along the edge as it nears the mining camp

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Forge Gate

exits.where: the Forge Gate ring standing in the upper band, its opening facing down onto the road (warp to Ferrox, 029)

sections.look: the Forge Mining Camp on a rocky shelf: black-stone huts with tin roofs and smoking chimneys (no doors on this side), rail tracks with carts of glittering ore along the edges, and the Forge Gate: a pale-stone ring taller than two houses carved with blue-glowing swirls, wrapped in rope-tied wooden scaffolding, with a stone console box at its base
sections.story_note: Ystran Relay Gate to Ferrox, guarded by Forge Miner Dax

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Fortress Gate
sections.look: outside the Helix Forge Fortress in black volcanic rock: the fortress is a sheer hard-white wall with floodlights, security cameras and the orange ring-and-slash logo (shape only) and NO door or opening on this screen; lava glow behind
sections.story_note: Helix Forge Fortress entrance, Helix grunt guard

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part A
sections.look: the Lava Bridges: wide iron bridges of riveted plates spanning glowing lava rivers, black basalt islands between channels, white steam

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B
sections.look: the Lava Bridges continued: riveted iron bridges over lava, cooling black crust, steam, and the first white Helix fences and floodlights along the far end

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Shuttle Pad

exits.where: the Helix shuttle boarding ramp at the back of the landing deck, 4 tiles wide (warp to the Station, 105)

sections.look: the Helix Shuttle Pad beside the Forge Fortress: a big white landing deck marked with the orange ring-and-slash logo (shape only), fuel lines and floodlights along the edges, black rock and lava glow around it
sections.story_note: Fortress Shuttle Pad to Helix Station

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Shadow Tunnel Mouth

exits.where: the Shadow Tunnel's dark arch in the upper rock wall, 6 tiles wide (warp to Umbra, 123)

sections.look: the Shadow Tunnel mouth on the far Frontier: black rock with a dark tunnel arch faintly carved with swirling marks, cold shadow pouring out of it, against warm lava glow
sections.story_note: Dark tunnel mouth leading to Umbra

sections.name: Molten Frontier: Magma Mines Gate

exits.where: the sealed red-glowing Ystran gate in the rock face at the end of the road, 6 tiles wide (warp to Pyros, 082)

sections.look: deep in Dustara's Magma Mines: black rock walls with timber props and mine rails along the edges, and at the end a sealed pale-stone Ystran gate set into the rock face, its swirling carvings glowing red
sections.story_note: Sealed glowing-red Ystran door to Pyros

sections.name: Gate Plaza

exits.where: the pale-stone Relay Gate ring (6 tiles wide, standing in the upper band, its opening facing down onto the road) where you arrive from Dustara's Forge Gate
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

exits.where: the same Relay Gate ring (warp back to Dustara's Forge Gate, 022)

sections.look: the Gate Plaza among the scrap: a pale-stone Relay Gate ring carved with swirls standing on riveted metal ground, scrap heaps towering around the edges, furnace-orange light
sections.story_note: Arrival plaza around the Relay Gate

sections.name: Rustvale
sections.look: Rustvale, Ferrox's town: buildings made of curved star-seed shell, pearly under rust; an old red caboose on a short siding as scenery; riveted plate streets; the dark riveted spire of the Relay Tower rising beyond the town edge
sections.story_note: Shanty town of shacks and converted rail cars

sections.name: Rustvale Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Rustvale Recovery Bay inside a curved star-seed shell dome: riveted metal-plate floor, pearly white curved walls, a nurse's counter against the back wall, glass-seashell healing machines glowing gold

sections.name: Rustvale Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Rustvale shop inside a riveted star-seed shell building: wall shelves of jars of screws sorted by color, fixed-up toys, spare gears and oil cans; one counter against the back wall; metal plate floor, hanging work lamps

sections.name: Grub's Workshop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Grub's scrap workshop: riveted shell walls, one long workbench of tools against the back wall, wall shelves of spare parts and coiled cables, an old engine in one corner, welding sparks

sections.name: Scrap Route Part A
sections.look: the Scrap Route: a long straight road along the bottom of a metal canyon between scrap heaps of rusted pipes, girders, broken wheels and bent gears, a broken Helix crate as an edge prop

sections.name: Scrap Route Part B
sections.look: the Scrap Route's far end: towering scrap heaps, iron rails along the edge, a tall water tower, and an old red caboose rusted onto a side track as scenery

sections.name: Crane Yard
sections.look: the Crane Yard: huge slow cranes and stacked containers along the edges, criss-crossing iron rails set flush into the riveted plate ground
sections.story_note: Swinging cranes, container stacks (Crane Yard Brawl)

sections.name: Junk Market
sections.look: the Junk Market, built under an old rusted bridge: a tidy row of stalls with striped tarps along the top of the map (broken radios, robot legs, jars of shiny screws, fixed-up toys), a Recovery Bay shell dome, and one big shop stall with a counter

sections.name: Furnace Ridge
sections.look: Furnace Ridge: a ridge of brick-and-iron chimneys and glowing furnace mouths along the edges, slag heaps, furnace-orange smoke; the road leads toward the dark riveted Relay Tower

sections.name: Ferrox Tower 1F
sections.look: inside the Ferrox Relay Tower, ground floor: a round hall of huge curved star-seed shell plates riveted with bolts as big as a head, pearly under rust, a ringing metal floor

sections.name: Ferrox Tower 2F
sections.look: the Ferrox Relay Tower top: the Keeper arena, a round riveted metal floor with stands against the walls, and the house-sized glowing blue crystal heart of the tower set against the back wall

sections.name: Landing Bog

exits.where: a flat round landing spot on the giant mushroom cap at the left end of the road (6×6 tiles, no ship drawn)
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

sections.look: the landing on top of a gigantic glowing mushroom cap as wide as a town plaza: flat, soft, springy and glowing pale green, with hundreds of glowing mushrooms in green, violet, blue and gold around the edges and misty swamp beyond
sections.story_note: Landing pad on a boardwalk in the bog

sections.name: Mirefen Village
sections.look: Mirefen Village: round woven-reed huts with moss-thatched roofs sitting on top of giant glowing mushroom caps, wide flat plank bridges joining the caps, and a wide open platform on the tallest central mushroom where the Spore Choir sings
sections.story_note: Stilt village of huts on mushroom stalks with rope bridges

sections.name: Mirefen Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Mirefen Recovery Bay inside a round woven-reed hut: moss-thatched ceiling, round windows, a nurse's counter against the back wall with glass-seashell healing machines lined with damp moss

sections.name: Mirefen Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Mirefen shop inside a woven-reed hut: wall baskets of glowing berries, jars of mushroom honey, moss cloaks and mushroom-cap hats on hooks, one counter against the back wall

sections.name: Lantern Marsh Part A
sections.look: the Lantern Marsh: still black water with WIDE straight wooden boardwalks on stilts, moss islands and tall reeds along the edges, and hundreds of floating paper lanterns (flowers, boats, birds, moons) glowing gold, pink and green on the water, never on the boardwalk
sections.story_note: Marsh of glowing lanterns and lily pads

sections.name: Lantern Marsh Part B
sections.look: the Lantern Marsh's end: a big round wooden platform in the black water ringed by floating paper lanterns, and a huge paper-moon lantern on its own raft beside it; reeds and mist along the edges
sections.story_note: Marsh of glowing lanterns and lily pads

sections.name: Mushroom Maze 1F
sections.look: the Mushroom Maze: a forest of giant pale mushroom stalks rising out of shallow water, their caps forming the walls; mossy ground lanes between them; some stalks dull ashy gray and cracked; soft glowing white mist at the edges only
sections.story_note: Maze of giant mushrooms (Lost in the Mist)

sections.name: Mushroom Maze 2F
sections.look: the heart of the Mushroom Maze: a clearing with white Helix tents and harsh floodlights along the edges, white boxy spore-vacuum machines with hoses pressed to dying gray mushroom stalks, thick black cables running along the walls to a gray power box
sections.story_note: Maze of giant mushrooms (Lost in the Mist)

sections.name: Spore Pools
sections.look: the Spore Pools: big round pools fitted together like honeycomb cells, each glowing green, violet or deep gold, separated by WIDE flat moss paths; the biggest gold pool at the foot of the giant mushroom-stalk tower

sections.name: Sporeholm Tower 1F
sections.look: inside the giant mushroom-stalk tower, ground floor: a round, tall lab with curving walls glowing soft pale green, wall shelves of glowing spore jars, potted plants against the walls, and a battle circle marked in glowing moss on the floor

sections.name: Sporeholm Tower 2F
sections.look: the mushroom tower's top: the Keeper arena under the cap, glowing green walls, a battle circle of glowing moss, and the tower's crystal heart set into the back wall

sections.name: Port Saltreach Docks

exits.where: a round stone landing pad (6×6 tiles, no ship drawn) at the left end of the dock street
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

exits.where: the same landing pad doubles as the Relay Gate arrival from Port Ember (018)

sections.look: Port Saltreach docks on the biggest island: wide stone docks and stone streets, white houses with red roofs, a boatyard with wooden sheds and lobster pots as scenery, tall-masted ships with white sails moored along the water edge, clear turquoise water
sections.story_note: Fog-bound docks, net sheds, stilt houses

sections.name: Saltreach Market
sections.look: Saltreach Market on the stone docks: a fish-market row of stalls with nets and crates, fishing boats tied in rows along the water edge, white houses with red roofs

sections.name: Saltreach Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Saltreach Recovery Bay inside a white stone building: blue tile floor, shells on the walls, round sea windows, a nurse's counter against the back wall with glass-seashell healing machines

sections.name: Saltreach Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Saltreach shop inside a white stone building: coils of rope, nets, lanterns, buoys and fish pies on wall shelves, one counter against the back wall, blue tile floor

sections.name: Lighthouse
sections.look: inside the old Gull Rock lighthouse: a round, salt-stained stone room with a stone staircase built into the wall, small round windows, a dark and quiet interior

sections.name: Coral Route Part A
sections.look: Coral Route: a wide white sandbar route across turquoise shallows so clear you see coral below, tiny white-sand islands with one or two skinny palms along the edges

sections.name: Coral Route Part B
sections.look: Coral Route continued: turquoise shallows, coral heads and sandbars, little palm islands along the edges

sections.name: Sea Arch Cove
sections.look: Sea Arch Cove: a giant stone sea arch standing over deep blue water in a turquoise cove, white sand beach, barnacled rocks along the edges
sections.story_note: Giant stone sea arch where Anchorath sleeps

sections.name: Harbor Tower 1F
sections.look: inside the Harbor Tower, ground floor: a big round tall white room with blue tiles in swirling wave patterns on the floor, round sea windows all around, and a tree-trunk-thick column of sea-blue crystal held by huge brass bolts against the back wall

sections.name: Harbor Tower 2F
sections.look: the Harbor Tower top: a round open balcony floor with a railing, blue wave tiles, an empty brass cradle where the sea-blue crystal sits, a brass spyglass on a stand

sections.name: Neonis Starport

exits.where: the big round landing ring painted on the rooftop deck (6×6 tiles, no ship drawn) at the left end of the road
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

sections.look: the Neonis Starport: a rooftop landing deck high among glass-and-steel towers, a big round landing ring painted on the deck, a glass elevator housing as scenery, holograms on the neighboring towers, glittering neon rain
sections.story_note: Floating landing deck with orange landing ring (rebuild at new scale)

sections.name: Neon Boulevard
sections.look: Neon Boulevard, the main neon street: wet reflective pavement under glittering rain, noodle stands and arcade fronts, holograms on the towers, a small park with a glowing purple fountain

sections.name: Neonis Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Neonis Recovery Bay inside a glass city building: white walls lit pink and blue from outside signs, a nurse's counter against the back wall, glass-seashell healing machines

sections.name: Neonis Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Neonis shop: wall shelves of glowing sneakers, gadgets and noodle cups, a glass counter against the back wall, a reflective floor

sections.name: Arcade District
sections.look: the Arcade District: arcade hall fronts with flashing (wordless) signs, a big plaza of glowing floor tiles, and the Grid Gardens power station of giant coils and sparking towers fenced off along one edge

sections.name: Broadcast Route Part A
sections.look: Broadcast Route over the rooftops: wide flat gravel rooftops joined by wide metal walkways, air vents, tall antennas and satellite dishes along the edges, a rooftop garden of glowing plants, and DJ Static's little metal antenna shack as scenery
sections.story_note: Route of antenna towers and cables (Pirate Radio)

sections.name: Broadcast Route Part B
sections.look: Broadcast Route continued: a chain of rooftop dishes along the edges, wet gravel rooftops and wide walkways leading toward the Voltspire's silver spiral
sections.story_note: Route of antenna towers and cables (Pirate Radio)

sections.name: Voltspire 1F
sections.look: inside the Voltspire, ground floor: glowing glass floor tiles, silver walls, a glass elevator shaft as a solid block against the back wall

sections.name: Voltspire 2F
sections.look: Voltspire middle floor: glowing glass floors and walls, cameras and sensors on the walls, neon light bleeding in

sections.name: Voltspire 3F
sections.look: the Voltspire top: an open-air arena with a round stage of flashing light tiles, stands and house-size speakers against the walls, and the huge electric-yellow icicle crystal crackling with lightning inside a cage of silver bars at the back

sections.name: Sunken Landing

exits.where: a small wooden jetty at the left end of the road where the Deep Sea Ferry surfaces (the ferry is not drawn)
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

exits.where: the same jetty (ferry back to the Long Dock, 019)

sections.look: the Sunken Landing: a little wooden jetty on a sand island in a calm glassy green sea, a great half-sunk stone tablet carved with swirls and leaning pillar pairs standing in the water around the edges

sections.name: Dig Camp
sections.look: the Dig Camp on a wide flat sand island: white and tan canvas tents with little flags, lanterns on poles, worktables of maps and brushes along the edges, old temple steps nearby
sections.story_note: Archaeologists' camp of tents and scaffolding

sections.name: Dig Camp Recovery Tent

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: the Dig Camp Recovery Tent: canvas walls and poles, woven mats on a sand floor, cots along one wall, and a glass-seashell healing machine behind a folding counter at the back
sections.story_note: Recovery Bay as a large tent

sections.name: Coral Ruins Part A
sections.look: Coral Ruins: flooded ruins in calm green water, half-sunk gray-and-gold temples leaning sideways along the edges, toppled pillars, a wide causeway of flat stone slabs

sections.name: Coral Ruins Part B
sections.look: Coral Ruins continued: wave-carved temple roofs and sunken windows lapped by the sea along the edges, a wide stone causeway with gold-inlaid swirls

sections.name: Glyph Hollow
sections.look: Glyph Hollow: a sandy hollow ringed by brown carved standing stones with glowing cracks, pebbles orbiting them on thin rings of pink light, gold-inlaid swirl carvings on cracked floor tiles
sections.story_note: Hollow of glowing glyph stones (Guardian Stones)

sections.name: Temple of Voices 1F
sections.look: inside the Temple of Voices, entrance hall: tall echoing pale-stone halls carved with glowing gold swirls, two tree-trunk columns with stone branches flanking the entrance, small wall crystals; the temple goes DOWN into the ground, so the top exit is a wide stair leading deeper
sections.story_note: Ancient Ystran temple (no Keeper), 3 floors (Song of the Chimes)

sections.name: Temple of Voices 2F
sections.look: the Temple of Voices, lower level: tall echoing pale-stone halls, gold-inlaid carvings, small glowing wall crystals, a wide stair at the top leading deeper still
sections.story_note: Ancient Ystran temple (no Keeper), 3 floors (Song of the Chimes)

sections.name: Temple of Voices 3F
sections.look: the deepest Temple chamber: a vast round domed room, pale smooth walls set with round polished-silver mirrors in carved frames, a single sunbeam making a bright circle on the floor, three tall standing stones against the back wall, and a huge round stone door with a crystal center (the way into the Mural Hall)
sections.story_note: Ancient Ystran temple (no Keeper), 3 floors (Song of the Chimes)

sections.name: Mural Hall

exits.where: the great round stone doorway back to the deepest temple chamber, a 2-tile gap in the bottom wall at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: the Mural Hall deep in the Temple of Voices: a hall so vast it feels like night, walls covered in house-sized faded murals painted with starlight paint (a crystal forest under a red sun, a great tree, seedpods drifting through space, an eight-star door), cracked and flaking
sections.story_note: Great hall of Ystran murals (M10b Vashti's confession)

sections.name: Cinder Hollow

exits.where: a round landing pad of iron plates (6×6 tiles, no ship drawn) at the left end of the road
exits.note: replaces the old 'arrival' edge exit, which was a ghost exit

sections.look: Cinder Hollow mining camp: timber shacks with tin roofs and brass furnace chimneys, rope lifts and mine-cart rails as scenery along the edges, lanterns, sulfur haze
sections.story_note: Mining camp of timber shacks, brass furnaces, rope lifts

sections.name: Cinder Hollow Recovery Bay

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Cinder Hollow Recovery Bay: a soot-stained timber-and-brass room, warm furnace light, a nurse's counter against the back wall with glass-seashell healers

sections.name: Cinder Hollow Shop

exits.where: a 2-tile-wide doormat in the bottom wall gap at columns 7–8, row 14

sections.look: Cinder Hollow shop: picks, helmet lamps, lanterns, rope coils and ore samples on wall racks, one counter against the back wall, soot-dark plank floor

sections.name: Lava Rail Part A
sections.look: the Lava Rail: a wide road beside a mine-cart rail line on trestles over lava, black rock, lava glow

sections.name: Lava Rail Part B
sections.look: the Lava Rail continued: rail switches and buffers along the edges, ore carts, black rock and lava glow

sections.name: Deep Mines B1
sections.look: Deep Mines B1: wide timber-propped tunnels in black rock, mine-cart rails set flush in the floor, lanterns on the props
sections.story_note: Deep mines, 3 levels (Teo's Trail 1, Deep Drill)

sections.name: Deep Mines B2
sections.look: Deep Mines B2: wider lava-lit galleries, lava cracks along the walls (never on the floor), timber props
sections.story_note: Deep mines, 3 levels (Teo's Trail 1, Deep Drill)

sections.name: Deep Mines B3
sections.look: Deep Mines B3: the deepest lava-lit gallery, timber props, and a small hidden ledge in one corner with an old metal cache box (Teo's first cache)
sections.story_note: Deep mines, 3 levels (Teo's Trail 1, Deep Drill)

sections.name: Furnace Ridge (Pyros)
sections.look: Furnace Ridge on Pyros: soot-black rock lined with brass forges and furnace chimneys along the edges, ore carts, ember-red glow; the road leads to the Volcano Tower

sections.name: Volcano Tower 1F
sections.look: inside the Volcano Tower, ground floor: black volcanic stone floor, lava channels behind grates along the walls, brass braziers, swirling Ystran carvings

sections.name: Volcano Tower 2F
